known.summary: the justification says the panel improved recall only on code-96 and tied on code-89, but the recorded results (the body's own table, line 158, and results.md Dev cases) give code-89 recall 0.83 for C3 it2 against 0.67 for C1 it2, so the correction understates the panel's measured benefit
